question:
DRAG DROP -
An engineer deploys a custom Guest Shell rootfs on a Nexus 9000 Series Switch. Drag and drop the steps from the left into the order required to deploy the solution on the right. Not all options are used.
items: Store it in a file server.
Import the Guest Shell rootfs to other switches.
Install the specific Guest Shell across devices simultaneously.
theory: Just like distributing a custom Guest Shell rootfs to multiple switches generally, the correct sequence is to customize the rootfs, export it as a package, store it centrally on a file server, import it to the target switches, and then install it across those devices simultaneously — a standard build-once, stage-centrally, deploy-fleet-wide workflow that avoids manually rebuilding the environment on each switch. (CCNP/CCIE DCCOR Official Cert Guide, Chapter 16 — Automation and Scripting Tools)
